Q1.rationale: Segment 5a expressly covers information 'whether in oral, written or electronic form', so verbally conveyed information is Confidential Information.
Q1.label: Entailment

Q2.rationale: The NDA has no general use restriction limited to stated purposes; segment 28 instead lets personnel use information retained in unaided memory 'for any purpose', which is incompatible with such a restriction.
Q2.label: Contradiction

Q3.rationale: Segment 17 sets obligations to expire at the earlier of sixty months after signing or completion of the Sale, so obligations continue beyond the agreement's date.
Q3.label: Entailment

Q4.rationale: Segment 28 gives a use right in information retained in unaided memory, and segment 15 only disclaims any commitment to supply information, so the NDA does not clearly bar granting rights and in part grants one.
Q4.label: Contradiction

Q7.rationale: Segment 21 requires the Disclosee to immediately notify the Sellers before disclosing Confidential Information under legal compulsion.
Q7.label: Entailment

Q8.rationale: The NDA contains no prohibition on reverse engineering.
Q8.label: NotMentioned

Q9.rationale: Segment 26 states that Confidential Information 'shall be limited to technical information' and 'shall not include business or financial information'.
Q9.label: Entailment

Q10.rationale: Segment 5c makes the fact of involvement in, and the status of, negotiations and 'any fact concerning the Sale' Confidential Information, so disclosing that the agreement was negotiated is restricted.
Q10.label: Entailment

Q11.rationale: Segment 5 includes advisors within Representatives and segment 2 allows disclosure to professional advisors with prior written consent of the Sellers.
Q11.label: Entailment

Q12.rationale: The NDA says nothing about acquiring similar information from third parties; its only third-party carve-outs concern public or previously possessed information.
Q12.label: NotMentioned

Q13.rationale: Segment 20 requires the breaching party to pay a US$500,000 penalty on any breach.
Q13.label: Entailment

Q15.rationale: The NDA contains no provision addressing the making of copies of Confidential Information.
Q15.label: NotMentioned

Q16.rationale: Segment 5 defines Confidential Information of any kind in any form without any requirement that it be expressly identified, which is incompatible with an identification requirement.
Q16.label: Contradiction

Q17.rationale: Segment 5 provides that Confidential Information may be provided to the Disclosee's employees (Representatives), so sharing with employees is permitted.
Q17.label: Entailment

Q18.rationale: Segment 2 requires prior written consent of the Sellers before any disclosure, and segment 21 covers disclosure to regulators only when legally compelled, with no exception for voluntary reports of violations of law.
Q18.label: Entailment

Q19.rationale: The NDA contains no export control provision; segment 3 refers only to Belgian insider dealing rules.
Q19.label: NotMentioned
